question: Solutions A and B contain acid and water in the ratio 3 ∶ 5 and 9 ∶ 7, respectively. Solution A and B are mixed into the ratio of 2 ∶ 3. What is the ratio of acid and water in the resulting solution?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/591b974e51a31414285e6d7db0726d51ec3fe6314c218220f7a183f96b9fb44a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

Solution A contain acid and water in the ratio 3 ∶ 5

Solution B contain acid and water in the ratio 9 ∶ 7

Solution A and B are mixed in the ratio 2 ∶ 3

**Calculation:**

Solution A total capacity = 3 + 5 = 8 units

Solution B total capacity = 9 + 7 = 16 units

Now we added solution A and B in 2 : 3

So Firstly we equal the capacity of solution A and B

Solution A = (3 + 5) × 2 = 16 units

That is equal to Solution B = 16 units

Now Solution A given in 2 ratio 

⇒ 16 × 2 = 32 units

Which contains Acid = (3/8) × 32 = 12 

Water = (5/8) × 32 = 20

And Solution B given in 3 ratio

⇒ 16 × 3 = 48 units

Which contains Acid = (9/16) × 48 = 27

Water = (7/16) × 48 = 21

In the resulting solution of A and B, we get

Acid = Solution A Acid + Solution B Acid

⇒ 12 + 27 = 39 

Water = Solution A water + Solution B Water

⇒ 20 + 21 = 41

**∴ The ratio of Acid and Water in Resulting mixture is 39 : 41.**
